groups.root_cause: Catalog additions that bring back a missing model are accepted without checking that model's saved routing and preference references against its new settings, so the daemon fails at its next startup.
The filtered operator routing is built once at startup and is not rebuilt when the catalog changes, so a restored model is not used for routing until the daemon restarts.
Building the URL for the SSH destination in src/cli/local.ts does not put brackets around IPv6 addresses, so it throws before any management command runs.

Provider matching in src/cli/local.ts does not account for providers reached through an SSH tunnel, so the health probe goes to the wrong endpoint without the API key and the provider's enablement is never updated.
The resume/retry check rejects a whole historical eval if any saved model is retired, when it should skip the retired model and continue with the available ones.

Startup validation of stored prefer and REMOVED_MODELS cells was weakened to treat any unknown value as a retired model, so a misplaced model ID gets a misleading error and the fail-loud tests were removed.
